categories.name: financial
categories.rules: Bank accounts, account closure, tax, and other financial administration specifically concerning this household. Property repair invoices go to property instead.

categories.name: legal
categories.rules: Court, property disputes, legal representation, and legal notices specifically concerning this household. Exclude generic legal marketing.

categories.name: property
categories.rules: Maintenance, valuation, sale, and repairs of property belonging to this household, including associated repair invoices.

decisions.reason: Property repair invoice. The rules explicitly state that property repair invoices belong in the property category, not financial.
Bank account closure letter. Clearly falls under bank accounts and account closure, which are explicitly listed financial administration items.
Court notice concerning a household records hearing. Explicitly matches legal notices specifically concerning this household.
Property maintenance inspection and work record (roof gutter clearing). Matches property maintenance category.
